title: What is a directory?
question: A directory is a file of names, each pointing to an inode. What happens when one is made, and when one is listed?

stops.note: A new directory: an inode, like a file's, all in one journal transaction.
Its first block, with its own two entries: "." (itself) and ".." (its parent).
The name "sub": into a block of /mnt, the parent.
Listing: read the directory's blocks, entry by entry.
Each entry, copied out to the program: its name, its inode, its type.
